basics.name: Pascal Garber
basics.label: Software developer: TypeScript, web, GNOME, native apps and AI
basics.summary:
Moin, I'm Pascal, a developer in Cuxhaven working in TypeScript on the web and the Linux desktop. I build [gjsify](https://gjsify.org/), which brings the Node.js and web ecosystem to GNOME apps, and write the apps that come out of it.

At CORRECTIV I work on the tools behind an independent newsroom; as JumpLink I take on client projects. I live with my two children by the sea. Away from the keyboard I like cycling, woodworking, survival, retro games and anime.

work.name: CORRECTIV
work.summary: Software for a non-profit newsroom. I now work in the Faktenforum team and lead the technical side of the new CORRECTIV app; before that I was in the beabee team.
highlights: Technical lead of the new CORRECTIV app and its workbench, which configures the app and publishes its documentation
Built Stamped, a tool to verify and explore leaked email archives locally
Work on Faktenforum, CORRECTIV's community fact-checking platform
beabee: hardened the security of the membership platform and built its Telegram integration

work.name: JumpLink / Art+Code Studio
work.summary: Client projects from concept to operation; today mostly GNOME apps and tooling.
highlights: GNOME apps in TypeScript on gjsify: Learn 6502 Assembly, Beifahrer, Steuererklärung
E-commerce since 2015: Shopify themes and apps, headless shops, frontend and backend for an international fashion retailer
